one step before, body already penetrating and moving left into the wall corner region

counterfactual.change: reduced controller vcmd from 11.4666 to 2.0 (one field) so approach speed stays low and corner contact resolves; same 353 steps, no violation

explanation: Controller at saturated fmax drives body leftward at ~9.4 m/s into the top corner of thin vertical wall (x=6.235,w=0.346,top y~6.82; body y~7.0,r=0.77). Grazing corner contact with only 2 substeps: impulse plus positional correction fails to push the circle out, so signed distance degrades from +0.327 at step 340 to -0.063 at step 350 to -0.138 at step 352 to -0.175 at step 353, accumulating penetration past the 0.15 limit while controller keeps pushing into the wall.
vision_note: The red controller-driven body moves left toward the green waypoint and perches on the top tip of the thin vertical wall. From step 350 to 353 it remains lodged on the corner and visibly sinks into overlap with the wall top instead of being deflected clear.
